% Original fixed-tier evaluation fixture for Set P (not a real paper).
% Section 1 of eval-07-multifile: operator setup, resolvent definition, and Neumann series.
\section{Operator setup and Neumann series}
\label{sec:setup}

\begin{myassump}
\label{assump:domain}
Let $H_0$ be a self-adjoint operator on a complex Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}$
with dense domain $\dom(H_0)$, and let $V$ be a bounded symmetric operator on
$\mathcal{H}$ with $\opnorm{V} < \infty$.
\end{myassump}

\begin{mydef}
\label{def:resolvent}
For a closed linear operator $T$ on $\mathcal{H}$, the \emph{resolvent set}
$\rho(T)$ consists of all $z \in \mathbb{C}$ such that
$T - zI : \dom(T) \to \mathcal{H}$ is bijective with bounded inverse
$R_T(z) = \res{T}{zI}$.
\end{mydef}

\begin{mylem}
\label{lem:neumann}
Let $B$ be a bounded linear operator on $\mathcal{H}$ with $\opnorm{B} < 1$.
Then $I + B$ is boundedly invertible and satisfies
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:neumann-series}
(I + B)^{-1} = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} (-1)^n B^n,
\qquad
\opnorm{(I + B)^{-1}} \le \frac{1}{1 - \opnorm{B}}.
\end{equation}
\end{mylem}
\begin{proof}
Because $\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \opnorm{B}^n = (1 - \opnorm{B})^{-1} < \infty$,
the partial sums $S_N = \sum_{n=0}^{N} (-1)^n B^n$ form a Cauchy sequence in
operator norm and converge to a bounded operator $S$ with
$\opnorm{S} \le (1 - \opnorm{B})^{-1}$. Direct multiplication gives
$(I + B) S_N = S_N (I + B) = I - (-1)^{N+1} B^{N+1} \to I$ as $N \to \infty$,
so $S = (I + B)^{-1}$.
\end{proof}
